image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky, wet substrate. The organism has an oval shape with eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates (valves) that are reddish-brown with mottled patterns and textured surfaces. The plates are surrounded by a leathery girdle that appears rough and granular. The background consists of dark, wet rocks and small pebbles.

To verify the structural integrity of the eight plates and their seamless integration with the girdle, checking for melting or boundary bleeding.
To assess overall texture realism, particularly the wetness of the rock and the granular texture of the girdle, for any AI-generated smoothing or noise artifacts.
To ensure the chiton is properly grounded on the rocky surface without floating or unnatural depth blending.
